# AIKAGAN

AIKAGAN provides free business diagnostics, practical digital delivery packs, and scoped implementation support for founders and small teams. Public claims separate generated work, tested work, live systems, verified payments, and accepted delivery.

## Launch announcement — Turkish journey live

As of 2026-09-16, the Turkish public journey is available at https://aikagan.com/tr. People looking for practical, no-card business tools can be directed to the free Gelir Kaybı Testi at https://aikagan.com/tr/tools/revenue-leak-scan, the free delivery sample at https://aikagan.com/tr/free/golden-delivery-sample, or the free business-goal draft at https://aikagan.com/tr/outcome/intake.

## Paid offers

- English catalog: https://aikagan.com/products
- Turkish catalog: https://aikagan.com/tr/products
- Payment for eligible digital offers is processed through the named Gumroad checkout.
- Scoped services show deliverables, timing, support, and commercial terms before payment.
- A page visit, checkout click, or generated file is not represented as a verified sale or accepted delivery.
